dreaddit.instruction: Classify whether the author expresses stress. Select exactly one label: 0=no stress, 1=stress.

goemotions.instruction: Identify the complete set of emotions expressed by the author. Select all supported labels in the official 28-label inventory. Neutral may coexist with other labels when warranted; do not force mutually exclusive labels.

cache.instruction: Code topics explicitly discussed using this provisional corpus-specific codebook. Select all supported topics. Do not infer hidden motives or personal attributes. Use insufficient_context alone if there is insufficient information. These codes are a local task transfer, not benchmark gold labels.

codebook.economic_hardship: Income, work, food or material insecurity.
codebook.healthcare_access: Access to health services, contraception or health information.
codebook.education: School attendance, school closure or learning.
codebook.relationships_gender: Relationships, gender expectations or relationship power.
codebook.sexual_reproductive_health: Sexual behaviour, pregnancy or reproductive health.
codebook.violence_safety: Coercion, abuse, violence or personal safety.
codebook.social_support: Family, peers, community support or isolation.
codebook.other: A substantive topic outside these categories.
codebook.insufficient_context: The excerpt does not supply enough information to code.
